meta.name: Real-estate card
meta.description: An address card laid out in HTML and CSS over an interior photo: label, address, city and a stat row, filled from typed fields, with a price tag that slides in after it.
meta.creativeDirection: Audience: estate agents who post listings as short videos. Direction: the photo carries the mood, the card carries the facts. One card, bottom left, on the theme surface with a soft shadow: an accent label, the address in display type, the city in the body face, then two stats. It rises in once the push-in has started; the price tag slides in from the right half a second later and both hold to the end. Copy comes from the fields, so the same template lists any property. Review: the card text is crisp at 720p, the corners are round, nothing is cut at the bottom of the card, and the price never covers the lamp.

sections.name: listing
sections.purpose: Present one property: where it is, what it offers and what it costs.

inputs.name: address_card
inputs.html:
For sale

{{ address }}

{{ city }}

{{ rooms }}{{ area }}
inputs.css: .card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 26px 32px 28px; border-radius: 28px; background: $color.surface@0.92; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) } .tag { color: $color.accent; font: 600 20px Rubik; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px } h2 { margin: 4px 0 0; color: $color.fg; font: 64px $font.display; line-height: 1 } .city { margin: 0; color: $color.muted; font: 400 24px Rubik } .stats { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px } .stat { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: $color.fg; font: 500 20px Rubik }

inputs.name: price_tag
inputs.css: .price { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 20px; background: $color.accent } small { color: $color.bg; font: 600 16px Rubik; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px } strong { color: $color.bg; font: 52px $font.display; line-height: 1.1 }
